fields.label: Background
fields.content: These uninhabited, barren, sub-Antarctic islands were transferred from the UK to Australia in 1947. Populated by large numbers of seal and bird species, the islands have been designated a nature preserve.

fields.label: Location
fields.content: islands in the Indian Ocean, about two-thirds of the way from Madagascar to Antarctica
